title: Pelt Delivery
html:
Quest Giver: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Deliver a bundle of pelts to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Hughard the Arms Merchant

Repeatable: No

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Deliver a bundle of pelts to Hughard the Arms Merchant in Townston.

Offer:

You gave me way more pelts here than I need for that coat I am making. Tell you what, take this bundle of pelts to Hughard in Townston. He'll sell them off for us, and I'll cut you in for some of the profits.

Hughard has a shop just outside the town square. Just follow the paths and you'll find him eventually. Big guy. You can't miss him.

Oh, I forgot...uh, Verily, Hughard the Arms Merchant shall be expecting thine arrival, good friend.

Turn-in:

Sir Lee of York mentioned you'd be arriving. Here's your portion of the profits.

Objectives:

  • Bundle of Pelts ×1

Client level range: 3–10
